systems.system: Registration of persons and issue of identity cards under the Registration and Identification of Persons Act (Chapter 36, Act No. 11 of 1986)
systems.owner: the Registrar appointed by the Minister responsible for citizenship
systems.tiers: registration offices the Minister may establish; persons aged eighteen and over, Mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar

note: The identity registration statute (excerpt, sections 1 to 14): registration of persons aged eighteen and over and identity cards. Its registration offices are identity offices; it says nothing on births, deaths or civil registration.
